identificationModule.briefTitle: Phase 3 Study of Intravitreal OLN324 in Adults With Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) (OLN324-CP-03)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-masked, Multicenter, Active Comparator-controlled Trial to Investigate the Efficacy and Safety of Intravitreal OLN324 in Adult Participants With Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) (GOBI)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a Phase 3 study of an investigational drug called OLN324, which is being developed by Ollin Biosciences as a treatment for patients with diabetic macular edema (DME).

interventions.name: OLN324
interventions.description: OLN324 by intravitreal injection at protocol-specified dosing intervals

interventions.name: Aflibercept
interventions.description: Aflibercept by intravitreal injection at protocol specified dosing intervals

primaryOutcomes.description: Change in ETDRS BCVA eye chart letter score from Day 1 to Week 48.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change in OCT CST in the Study Eye from baseline at Week 20
secondaryOutcomes.description: Difference in the mean change from baseline in OCT CST in the Study Eye between the OLN324 arm and the aflibercept arm

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of participants with absence of DME in the Study Eye at Week 20
secondaryOutcomes.description: Difference in the percentage of participants with absence of DME in the Study Eye between the OLN324 arm and the aflibercept arm

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to DME resolution in the Study Eye
secondaryOutcomes.description: Difference in the time to first DME resolution in the Study Eye
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Enrollment through study completion, an average of 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change in OCT CST in the Study Eye from baseline at Week 48

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Capable of giving signed informed consent
* Be ≥18 years of age.
* Have type 1 or type 2 diabetes mellitus
* Have a decrease in vision in the study eye due to diabetic macular edema (DME), with best corrected visual acuity of 78 to 25 letters
* Have macular edema on OCT with a CST of ≥ 325 µm
* Participants may be either treatment-naïve or previously-treated for DME in their study eye. The number of previously-treated participants is limited.
* Additional inclusion criteria apply

Exclusion Criteria:

* Be pregnant or breastfeeding
* History of cataract surgery in the study eye within 90 days of Screening
* Has uncontrolled glaucoma in the study eye
* Has uncontrolled hypertension
* Has had a stroke or myocardial infarction within 180 days
* If in the cohort of previously treated for DME participants, prior treatment with intravitreal bevacizumab, aflibercept, faricimab, ranibizumab, conbercept, or other approved anti-VEGF or Anti-VEGF/Anti-Ang-2 therapies within 90 days of randomization.
* Additional exclusion criteria apply
